status: canonical computation and provider terminology documented; historical provider filtering remains bounded by supplied evidence

common.scope: Inherited canonical state after a source week for prediction of a later game. TDNet consumes provider per-game advanced or havoc fields; it does not refit the provider PPA model. Numeric duplicate fingerprint-key rows are averaged first; then nonmissing values are equally averaged within team-season through the source week.
common.weighting: This is a mean of per-game values, not a play-weighted pooled rate. Source week regular-season filtering and frozen experiment availability checks still apply.
common.minimum_sample_rule: One finite supplied canonical value. Provider qualification/support rules govern the per-game statistic; no new sample threshold is imposed by this cumulative mean.
common.garbage_time_handling: The inherited fetch passes no explicit garbage-time switch to /stats/game/advanced or /stats/game/havoc; retain supplied provider values. Do not assert a historical filtering policy solely from current glossary wording.
common.provider_definitions_reference: https://apinext.collegefootballdata.com/metrics-and-definitions (read 2026-09-27; page modified 2026-09-26). This identifies provider terminology, not proof of unchanged implementation across historical API versions.
common.provider_terms: PPA is play-level change in predicted scoring value. Explosiveness averages PPA over successful plays. Success uses 50%, 70%, 100% of needed yards on downs one, two, three/four. Passing downs are second-and-eight-plus or third/fourth-and-five-plus. Stuffing stops a rush at or behind the line. Power success concerns runs needing at most two yards. Havoc covers tackles for loss, forced fumbles, interceptions and pass breakups; front-seven and defensive-back measures select their provider event subsets.

defense_db_havoc_rate.positive_negative_meaning: Nonnegative disruption share; defense records disruption created and offense records disruption allowed. Negative values have no rate meaning.
defense_db_havoc_rate.film_intuition: Disruptive plays created or suffered; the named unit restricts the event category.

defense_drives.positive_negative_meaning: Nonnegative activity count; larger means more recorded volume, not necessarily better efficiency.
defense_drives.interpretation: Opponent production against the defense; all included plays.

defense_explosiveness.units: predicted points added per successful play
defense_explosiveness.positive_negative_meaning: The sign follows the scoring-value change of successful plays; larger magnitudes describe their average value, not their frequency.
defense_explosiveness.interpretation: Opponent production against the defense; all included plays.
defense_explosiveness.film_intuition: Value gained when a play succeeds, distinct from how often it succeeds.
